purpose: Teach: オマケ/脳みそ/右肩/負け犬/ペースト/方角/かわし/ひきこもり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にオマケのクッキーをお渡ししようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, Aoi, we should give that customer a complimentary cookie.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion with warmth. Soft onset. Moves at ease—not pushing, inviting. A small smile in the voice. Trails off slightly on the final phrase, as if offering rather than instructing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー考案で脳みそフル稼働ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I know. My brain's been running at full capacity with this new menu idea.
lines.style: Self-aware, a touch wry. Quick, energetic attack on 「脳みそ」. Slightly breathless—caught in the middle of thinking. Doesn't expect sympathy, just acknowledgment. Light and honest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、右肩を回されてストレッチされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I noticed that customer stretching out their right shoulder earlier.
lines.style: Quiet observation without intrusion. Gentle, almost conversational. Paces slowly—giving Aoi room to hear it. Soft, caring undertone. No alarm, just noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、競合に負け犬扱いされない店にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want this place to be somewhere that doesn't feel like a losing game against the competition.
lines.style: Firmer conviction here. Lands on 「負け犬扱い」 with quiet resolve. Slower pace. Not angry—determined. The voice of someone protecting something small but precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューのアボカドペーストが好評ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The avocado paste on the new menu has been getting good feedback.
lines.style: Pleased, genuine warmth. Lighter onset. Pace is steady and easy—sharing something good without needing to oversell it. A small lift at the end, like a gift being offered.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の方角的に午後は日差しがきついね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, the afternoon sun hits this spot pretty hard because of where the store is facing.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Conversational, not complaining. Even pacing. Slight pause mid-thought—practical mind working through a detail. Grounded and clear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クレームをかわしながら笑顔だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer handled a complaint so well—just kept smiling through it all.
lines.style: Noticing something admirable without fanfare. Quiet respect underneath. Slow, steady delivery. Soft gaze in the voice. Trailing end—as if pointing something out for Aoi to see, too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ひきこもりがちなお客様にも優しい店にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want to make this a place where even people who tend to keep to themselves feel welcome.
lines.style: Determined and genuine. Soft opening, gathering momentum. Measured pace—each phrase matters. Not performative, but sincere. The voice of someone who means it.
